title: The Snowy Cabin
answer: B, the skier. It snowed until midnight. If she'd walked back at six, the new snow would have covered her footprints. They were on top, so she walked after midnight.

beats.line: Ms. Frost was found dead in her mountain cabin. Three friends were staying nearby. One of them is lying.
That night, it snowed until midnight.
Suspect A. The guide says he never left the lodge.
Suspect B. The skier says she got back at six, long before the snow stopped.
Suspect C. The friend says she was asleep all night.
But leading from the cabin were the skier's footprints, right on top of the fresh snow.

visual.label: Skier's prints: on top of fresh snow

beats.line: So, who's lying? A, B, or C?
Comment your answer. The solution is in the pinned comment.
